narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a celebratory concert vlog documenting the band 'Ideal Mix' (Bestards) performing their first large-scale concert at the Taipei Arena. It uses emotional song highlights and narrative voiceover to share the milestone achievement with fans, emphasizing the surprise guest appearance of Wu Qingfeng and the overall sentimental journey of the band over eight years.
